## v0.2.0 — Timer & Stopwatch, 2-level navigation, Cardputer-Adv keyboard

Minor release. Adds two new NVS-backed apps and unifies header/content focus across all apps. Cardputer-Adv **Fn+arrow** keys are supported.

**Apps (left/right in the header):** Torch → Timer → Stopwatch → IR Remote

---

### New: Timer

Countdown timers stored in flash (NVS namespace `card_adv_tm`).

- Up to **8** timers; **0–23 h**, **0–59 min** (no seconds)
- **List:** saved timers + `+ New`
- **Edit:** Hours / Minutes / `> Start` / `x Remove`
- **Running:** remaining time on list (`H:MM:SS` or `M:SS`); **Enter** cancels
- **Done:** shows `DONE`; **Enter** clears done state
- Timers survive reboot; running timers continue counting down in background

### New: Stopwatch

Named stopwatch with history in NVS (`card_adv_sw`).

- Default name `"Run"` (editable, max 24 chars)
- **Start / Stop** — centisecond display (`M:SS.CS` or `H:MM:SS.CS`)
- **Stop** saves record to **History** (max **10** entries)
- **History** screen: scroll with ↑↓, ← or Del to return

---

### Navigation & header (all apps)

Two-level focus model:

1. **Header focus** (header) — bar is **navy**, title **yellow**
   - `←` `→` switch apps (wraps)
   - `↓` or **Enter** enter app content
2. **App focus** — bar is grey, title white
   - **↑** from top of root screen returns to the header

Page dots and battery icon sit in the header bar. Entering or switching apps starts in header focus.

**Cardputer-Adv:** Fn+arrow keys emit USB HID codes; v0.2.0 reads both printed arrow keys (`; , . /`) and HID usage IDs so navigation works on v1.x and Adv boards.

---

### Torch

- Fixes full-screen white **flicker** on brightness/blink/countdown updates (partial redraw only)
- Header focus disables row highlight until you press ↓ into the app
- Removed bottom on-screen hint text

### IR Remote

- **Lazy hardware init:** TX only on send, RX only on Learn (less overhead when browsing)
- **Device list simplified:** devices + `* New Device` only (rename/remove moved to detail)
- **Device detail:** `+ Learn`, `* Rename` (device), `x Delete` (button), `x Remove` (device)
- Receiver LED feedback disabled during learn

### Battery indicator

The header shows **icon only** (no % text). Color by level; lightning glyph when charging.

---

### Upgrade from v0.1.1

| Data | Notes |
|------|--------|
| IR devices/buttons | Kept (`card_adv` namespace unchanged) |
| Timer / Stopwatch | New; empty on first use |
| Pins & Torch defaults | Unchanged (IR TX GPIO 44, RX GPIO 1) |

Install `cardputer_adv_firmware.bin` via M5Launcher (SD / OTA / WUI). Do not flash to `0x0` with esptool unless you intend to replace M5Launcher.

Serial boot line: `cardputer_adv_firmware 0.2.0`

---
